title: Contract Watch: facts are not decisions
audience: API owners who need semantic contract changes, policy consequence, and unknown consumer scope kept separate.
promise: Compare two explicit OpenAPI contracts, classify changes with bounded certainty, and record a human disposition without inventing a release verdict.
story: A baseline and candidate contract produce explicit additions, removals, response changes, and deprecations.
Certainty and policy consequence remain separate fields for each change.
A human acknowledges or mitigates selected changes while others remain unreviewed.
Undocumented consumers and runtime traffic remain explicit limitations.
verified_locally: Real OpenAPI fixture with four semantic change kinds.
Separate certainty/consequence fields and human dispositions preserved.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass.
Current dev comparison and disposition flows were rerun headlessly.
1600×900 PNG/SVG preview was regenerated and visually reviewed.
open_gates: Hand the source identity to Review Attention Map and Deletion Proof without copying authority.
Expand undocumented-consumer and stale-baseline fixture coverage.
Connect the local case to a hosted no-auth URL and verify it.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a local W3 OpenAPI semantic-diff slice; it does not claim complete consumer impact, merge/release policy, cross-tool integration, hosting, or publication.
